key_insight: The proposed Four-Step Action Loop links Sense, Process, Choose and Execute, with feedback shaping future perception and action.
engineering_relevance: This is a conceptual self-regulation framework, not an AI or solid-mechanics method; its engineering relevance is limited to a feedback-loop analogy.
method: Integrates perception–action, interoceptive inference and autonomic-response models.
Maps body-based practices to loop stages and proposed mechanisms.
Translates the framework into four practitioner skills and seven testable propositions.
evidence_signal: Developed over six workshop cohorts of non-clinical adults, the framework offers seven propositions for future testing; the abstract reports no quantitative efficacy results.
watch_item: Proposed mechanisms and benefits require validation; the framework is intended for wellbeing, not treatment.
paper_title: The Four-Step Action Loop with Feedback: A teachable perception-action framework for everyday self-regulation
